issues: The trigger filter is not encoded in a supported location; encode the once-per-turn trigger as timing "onAllyFollowerEnter" with a condition/filter for the entering follower being a Dragon token, rather than a top-level unsupported "filter" field.

Replace the noop stub with a real effect once available; implement an operation for the targeted card's controller to optionally play/summon a follower or amulet from hand.
The card is missing the Stack keyword/effect; encode the amulet's printed Stack ability in addition to the fanfare banish effect.
The fanfare ability is wrapped in an unnecessary always-if; encode it directly as a banish effect targeting an enemy follower with maxDef 4.
